query:
UPDATE characters
           SET race = COALESCE(race, $2), sex = COALESCE($3, sex),
               level = GREATEST(level, COALESCE($4, level)),
               reached_60_at = CASE WHEN GREATEST(level, COALESCE($4, level)) = 60
                                    THEN COALESCE(reached_60_at, now()) END
           WHERE id = $1
